messages:
Nora (PM): Quick heads-up — infra regression this morning means we need to rethink the MVP cutlist. Can we do a quick sync here?
Diego (Eng): Which items are on the chopping block?
Nora (PM): Primary risk is per-tenant promptstore + tenant UI. If we keep both, delivery slides 2 sprints.
Ava (Design): Design team can deprioritize tenant-specific screens — core flow remains intact.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Cutting promptstore shaves ~30% off the infra work we have queued. Reduces ops risk for launch.
Jules (CTO): Who is this blocking on the customer side? Any contractual pilots?
Nora (PM): One paid pilot asked for tenant presets. Sales is okay with a temporary workaround (manual proxy + labels) if we commit to v1 date for promptstore.
Diego (Eng): Technical note: promptstore also impacts embeddings cache warmup. If removed, we can keep KV-prefetch and still hit latency targets.
Ava (Design): UX note: if we remove tenant UX, we should add a small CTA explaining the workaround so pilot customers aren't confused.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Also recommend we keep the caching instrumentation in MVP so we can monitor and roll back quickly.
Nora (PM): Proposal: cut "tenant promptstore" and "tenant-specific settings" from MVP -> move to v1. Keep caching, KV-prefetch, and the core routing. Decision by EOD so we can update release notes.
Diego (Eng): :+1: I can produce a cut-diff and updated milestone plan. If we keep promptstore, we need a freeze extension to Feb 15.
Jules (CTO): Trade-off sounds reasonable. We should capture the customer promise and timeline in the pilot agreement.
Nora (PM): Action items: Diego updates cutlist & milestone diff; Sam to quantify infra savings and risk delta; Ava to annotate mock flows and write the UX fallback copy; Jules to confirm messaging for sales.
Diego (Eng): Uploaded diff: /docs/release/cut-diff-1710101010.md (high level, files changed).
Sam (Eng-Infra): Quick estimate: cutting promptstore removes 3 infra tickets and reduces expected staging burst cost by ~15%.
Ava (Design): UX copy suggestion: "Tenant presets are coming in v1. For now, please use the temporary workspace tag flow — reach out to your CSM for help"
Nora (PM): Perfect. We'll lock the cut and treat promptstore as a carry-forward item with target v1 sprint. Can we still do the canary on Thurs?
Diego (Eng): Yes — with the cut, canary on staging Thu, ship Tue.
deploy-bot: RC build 2024-02-08 is deploying to staging now.
Nora (PM): OK locking this. Thanks team. Closing thread — will post the updated milestone board after Diego's diff. :tada:
Diego (Eng): Done — updated milestone board and PR labels. Will ping if anything blocks.
